title: AM v2 heads: richer point-in-time features (structure, market state, index/regime state) and re-fit Stage A
note: Stage A used only 6 path features + side/tf/strategy; incremental skill over the (strategy x open_r decile x bar-age) lookup is small (+0.01..0.035 loss, AUC .747 vs .724). Add point-in-time features computed from bars <= k: distance to nearest prior swing high/low in R, range position, 4h trend sign, ATR regime, BTC / index return since entry, breadth, funding; also the index/regime state the bear-ML work needs. Extend scripts/research/cf_bar_labels.py (features block) and re-run cf-bar-labels (default corpus_sha = run w) + am_heads_fit.py; new unit with the same STAGE_A_RULE shape registered first; compare skill vs the SAME state baseline. No lookahead test required for every new feature (see tests/test_cf_bar_labels.py).
